## Everything you need to care together

Powerful, gentle tools designed for the real, messy, loving work of caregiving.

### Medication tracking

Shared schedules, real-time updates, and photo verification so a dose is never missed.

### Appointment coordination

Plan doctor visits, assign who's driving, and keep every appointment in one shared calendar.

### Care team coordination

See who's free, who helped last, and split tasks so no one person carries it all.

### Document vault

Insurance cards, records, and prescriptions stored securely and ready the moment you need them.

### Medication interaction check

Screen medicines for common interactions and get a clear list to review with your pharmacist.

### Care readiness score

One number that shows how emergency-ready your care circle is — with gentle next steps.

## Calm, clear, and made for families

#### Know you're ready

A readiness score with simple next steps.

#### Share the load

Assign tasks so the circle carries it together.

#### A moment for you

Because caring for them starts with you.

## Start caring together today

Join thousands of families who've made caregiving calmer with CompassCare. Free for 7 days.

## Frequently asked questions

How does the 7-day free trial work?

You get full access to every feature for 7 days, completely free. If you love it, your plan begins automatically after the trial. If it's not for you, cancel anytime before the trial ends and you won't be charged.

What's the difference between the plans?

Monthly ($3.99) and Yearly ($39.99) are subscriptions and both include the 7-day free trial — Yearly works out to $3.33/month. Lifetime ($79.99) is a single one-time payment with no subscription, ever, including all future updates.

Can my whole family use one account?

Yes. CompassCare is built for care circles — invite parents, siblings, and helpers so everyone sees the same medications, appointments, and shared tasks in real time.

Is my family's information secure?

Absolutely. CompassCare uses bank-level encryption and HIPAA-compliant practices. Your loved one's health information stays private and protected.

How do I cancel?

Manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your App Store or Google Play account settings — no emails, no hoops. Cancel at least 24 hours before your trial ends to avoid being charged.

Which languages are supported?

CompassCare is fully localized in 17 languages, including Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, and more.
